Newcastle vs Everton predictions
 Over 4.5 Cards – 1.80 – Everton ousted Newcastle (3-1) in the Carabao Cup on Merseyside on Thursday evening and there was a real edge to proceedings, especially in the second half when tempers boiled over.
 Four players had already been booked before a late fracas broke out between Everton pair Jordan Pickford and James Tarkowski, and Magpies duo Joelinton and Dan Burn. All four players were cautioned, bringing the total card count up to eight at Hill Dickinson Stadium.
 Monday’s rematch is an immediate chance for those scores to be settled, so expect the match officials to be kept busy at St. James’ Park.
